# Spar 0.6.0

**Spar 0.6 is the Pi-agent release. The Training Agent now runs on Pi's native
agent loop, keeps its real tool calls under Spar's host controls, and can hold a
conversation open while it waits for the learner instead of turning every answer
into a new, disconnected turn.**

## The Training Agent now runs on Pi

- **Pi 0.85 replaces Mastra in the agent runtime.** Spar now drives the provider
  through Pi's native loop, while the desktop host still owns permissions,
  persistence, question validation, execution limits, and final verdicts.
- **Tools are enforced by the stage the learner is in.** The agent receives the
  tool set required for the next part of the training loop, so it cannot skip
  the evidence, target, or validation work that makes a challenge trustworthy.
- **Oversized provider prompts recover.** A turn that exceeds a provider's
  context limit is reduced to the active evidence and resumed, rather than
  ending the session with an opaque failure.

## Conversations can wait for you

- **The agent can ask several real questions in one turn.** A question pauses
  the provider clock while you answer, then the same training turn continues
  with that answer in context.
- **Interrupt, edit, and redirect a live turn.** Your next message reaches the
  active run at its next safe boundary. You can also edit an earlier message and
  have Spar continue from the corrected conversation.
- **The transcript shows work as work.** In-progress messages stay visibly
  waiting until the agent takes them up, and completed tool activity folds under
  the reply it produced instead of becoming a separate wall of logs.

## Results show the whole run

- **Fail-fast hidden checks retain the complete grid.** A generated hidden file
  can contain dozens of cases; Spar now records the validated case total rather
  than mistaking one file for one case. A failure on case one shows every later,
  unvisited case in grey.
- **The result arrives as one answer.** After the existing dot-grid animation
  finishes, the verdict and the failing case's input, output, and expected value
  appear together.
- **Hidden-case evidence is readable.** Generated case names yield their input
  in the evidence panel, so a private failure says what was actually run.

## Downloads

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac, Apple silicon | `Spar-0.6.0-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac, Intel | `Spar-0.6.0.dmg` |
| Windows | `Spar-0.6.0-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `Spar-0.6.0-x86_64.AppImage` or `Spar-0.6.0-amd64.deb` |

## Known limits

- This open distribution is unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen
  may ask you to approve the first launch, and those platforms may require a
  manual installer step for an update.
- Linux AppImage installations can self-update when the runtime supports it;
  `.deb` installations remain managed by the system package manager.
